paper.title: NanoBench: A Multi-Task Benchmark Dataset for Nano-Quadrotor System Identification, Control, and State Estimation

hardware.caveat: Current v2 paper and README agree on measured 40.85 g instrumented mass versus stock 27 g. The model mass does not match this as-flown mass. Exact arm geometry remains unverified.

directory_inventory.interpretation: 107 is directory-scoped. Whole repository also has benchmark data and results. Equal Git blob IDs identify repeated file content at this pin; no inference about trial independence, dependence, cause or misconduct.

candidates.measurement_description: Documented synchronized/resampled 100 Hz flight telemetry includes four PWM commands, battery voltage, IMU, Vicon pose and derived vehicle velocity, and estimator/controller states. Battery voltage is forward-filled. CSV payloads not fetched; two small YAML metadata files and pinned README/LICENSE inspected.
candidates.permitted_interpretation: Partial actuator/supply/timing reference; command thrust is not measured force.
candidates.estimator_caveat: README CSV Column Reference note and v2 section III-B describe Vicon pose supplied to the EKF; Vicon-aided estimates are not an independent ground truth.
